source_binding.title: Unifying Generic Group Models
source_binding.bound_scope: average-case prime-order pG_dense, or pG_dense,ro with the exact shared ro(v)=RO(pi(v)) interface

mpz_meter.preprocessing: unlimited allowed interactions, but target x is absent
mpz_meter.phase_boundary: all game registers are cleared before main

advice.definition: the length |z| of the sole ordinary advice string from S.pre to S.main

main.definition: the total computation operations and function queries answered in one S.main phase

mpz_meter.local_computation: MPZ does not meter arbitrary solver-local bit operations; this census nevertheless assigns every externally mediated equality, handle, predicate, decoder, or replay action to k and rejects any unmodeled oracle.
mpz_meter.registers: unlimited in Theorem 3 and Corollary 3 during a phase, but none persist across the clear

phase_crossing_advice_census.item: preprocessed predicate object and all auxiliary tables
all five decks' occurrence labels, signs, indices, and scalar lineage if retained
all five decks' dense representations if retained rather than reconstructed
canonical dyadic restriction metadata and selected branch transcript if replayed
phase_crossing_advice_census.bound: B^(1+o(1)) bits under a full materialization; B^(o(1)) for the path alone

phase_crossing_advice_census.item: solver randomness, replay seeds, indices, pointers, and cached outputs used in main
phase_crossing_advice_census.bound: must be included in ell_total; no unbounded word is allowed

phase_crossing_advice_census.charge: not representable as persistent MPZ state after clear
phase_crossing_advice_census.bound: must instead serialize usable ordinary data into ell and reconstruct registers in main under k

fifth_deck_lifecycle_alternatives.alternative: retain ordinary dense representations and labels
fifth_deck_lifecycle_alternatives.main_charge: construct W, one dense(W) query, 2m local exact comparisons, decode, and verify; conservatively O(m+log(N))=B^(1+o(1)) interactions
fifth_deck_lifecycle_alternatives.validity: valid because pi is the same model parameter across phases even though registers are cleared

fifth_deck_lifecycle_alternatives.alternative: reconstruct all signed F_4 registers in main from public scalar lineage
fifth_deck_lifecycle_alternatives.preprocessing_charge: only ordinary labels and reconstruction recipe, at most B^(1+o(1)) bits
fifth_deck_lifecycle_alternatives.main_charge: O(m*log(N)) group operations under conservative independent scalar multiplication, 2m dense queries, 2m comparisons, plus decode and verification = B^(1+o(1))
fifth_deck_lifecycle_alternatives.validity: valid because the deck is public, target-independent, full, labelled, and reconstructible
conservatively charging both still preserves both declared exponents

fifth_deck_lifecycle_alternatives.alternative: retain opaque external handles or an uncharged service
fifth_deck_lifecycle_alternatives.validity: outside MPZ and outside the frozen theorem

main_interaction_census.action: obtain the game-provided x register, generate 1, construct [C]P, and form R=Q+[C]P
main_interaction_census.charge: O(log(N)) operations in k; game initialization itself is not a solver interaction

main_interaction_census.action: construct or rebind all 8m signed occurrences and their exact labels
main_interaction_census.charge: O(m*log(N)) allowed operations/queries in k under conservative reconstruction

main_interaction_census.action: construct or expose all 2m signed F_4 occurrences and their exact labels
main_interaction_census.charge: O(m*log(N)) allowed operations/queries in k unless their dense values were serialized in ell
every +, 1, dense, ro, equality-mediated, handle, replay, and reconstruction interaction made by the inlined predicate is included in the one aggregate k; there is no per-call k reset
main_interaction_census.asymptotic_B_exponent: at most 5/4+o(1) by the frozen aggregate premise

main_interaction_census.action: describe canonical halves, retain a branch, and map occurrence labels to current generic registers
main_interaction_census.charge: local bit work is solver-internal; every external or generic access is counted in k

main_interaction_census.action: all ro(v)=RO(pi(v)) calls made anywhere in the main transcript
main_interaction_census.charge: one k interaction per ro call, covered by Corollary 3

main_interaction_census.action: compute W=R-sum_{i=0}^3 e_i using allowed additions and explicit inverses/scalars
main_interaction_census.charge: O(log(N)) conservative group operations in k

main_interaction_census.action: obtain dense(W), obtain or read dense representations for every F_4 occurrence, and compare all 2m labels
main_interaction_census.charge: at most 2m+1 dense queries plus 2m conservatively charged comparisons and reconstruction work in k

main_interaction_census.action: compute xhat modulo N from the five labels
main_interaction_census.charge: local O(polylog(N)) bit work; any external interaction is included in k

main_interaction_census.action: compute [xhat]P and compare it exactly with Q before output
main_interaction_census.charge: O(log(N)) additions plus dense/equality access in k

main_interaction_census.action: every reconstruction, retry, replay, or transcript-consistency interaction actually used
main_interaction_census.charge: included once in the same hard aggregate k; expected or per-call accounting is not accepted

main.qualification: k_total is the actual complete transcript count, not a budget reused independently for each predicate call

source_proof_regime.check: Theorem 3 states the bound directly; its proof also contains log(N) terms before the final simplification.
source_proof_regime.application: ell=B^(9/4+o(1)) dominates log(N), so those source-level logarithmic terms do not alter the certified exponent.

success_quantifier.event: one complete mutually consistent adaptive transcript ending with a candidate that passes [xhat]P=Q
success_quantifier.distribution: uniform target x modulo prime N and uniform dense representation pi, together with allowed setup and solver randomness
success_quantifier.required_solver_success: bounded away from zero asymptotically for the complete transcript
success_quantifier.reason: The MPZ theorem bounds one S.main random system with one actual aggregate k. The frozen universal exact premise supplies nonvanishing average success only when the whole adaptive reduction succeeds jointly.

interface_failure_conditions: any phase-crossing state not serialized into ell ordinary bits
any persistent opaque generic handle after the MPZ register clear
any external predicate, coordinate, representation-leakage, or target-local oracle outside {+,1,dense,ro}
any per-call or expected interaction budget substituted for the one actual aggregate k
any claim based only on marginal rather than complete-transcript success
any fifth deck whose labels or usable encodings cannot be retained in ell or reconstructed in k

scope.validated: only the J2 MPZ source/model binding and full advice/interaction exponents for exactly four subset-stable decks plus one public full labelled reconstructible scanned deck
not_validated: J1 isolation, collision, and labelled-decoder correctness
J3 three-deck control, global scope, or steering boundary
an algorithm, attack, speedup, closure, or breakthrough
